rows.label: Corporate income tax (federal and provincial) [national and provincial]
rows.value: Federal 15% general, 9% small business up to $500,000; provinces add 0%–3.2% (lower) and 8%–15% (higher); 15% global minimum tax. Paid by corporations. Income Tax Act s. 123, 123.4, 124, 125; Global Minimum Tax Act

rows.label: Branch profits tax (Part XIV) [national]
rows.value: 25%, reduced by treaty. Paid by non-resident corporations with a Canadian branch. Income Tax Act s. 219, 219.2

source.title: Income Tax Act, Part XIV, s. 219 and s. 219.2 (current to 2026-10-19)

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (CPP or QPP, QPIP, optional EI) [national (QPP and QPIP: Quebec)]
rows.value: CPP 11.9% from $3,500 up to $74,600, maximum $8,460.9; QPP 12.6%. Paid by self-employed individuals. Canada Pension Plan s. 10; Act respecting the Québec Pension Plan; Employment Insurance Act

source.title: CRA: CPP contribution rates, maximums and exemptions (page details 2026-11-09); Second additional CPP contribution (CPP2) rates and maximums (page details 2026-11-09)

rows.label: Contractor rules (employee or self-employed test, personal services business, T4A reporting) [national]
rows.value: No withholding on resident contractors; 5% extra corporate tax on personal services business income; 15% withheld from non-resident contractors. Paid by payers and contractors. CRA RC4110; Income Tax Act s. 123.5, 125(7); Income Tax Regulations s. 105

source.title: Income Tax Act s. 125(7) 'personal services business' and s. 123.5 (current to 2026-10-19); CRA fact sheet 'Personal services businesses' (psb-fs-en.pdf)

rows.label: Simplified quick method of accounting for small businesses [national]
rows.value: GST/HST remittance rates from 1.8% to 10% of GST/HST-included sales, up to $400,000 of sales. Paid by small GST/HST registrants who elect it. Excise Tax Act; CRA RC4058

source.title: CRA: RC4058 Quick Method of Accounting for GST/HST (page details 2025-07-21); CRA: When to register for and start charging the GST/HST (page details 2026-06-16)

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national and provincial]
rows.value: Normal federal rates plus provincial tax where earned in a province, or a 48% federal surtax; payroll withholding under Regulation 102. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by employers). Income Tax Act s. 2(3), 115, 120; Income Tax Regulations s. 102

source.title: Income Tax Regulations s. 102; Income Tax Act ss. 115(1), 120(1), 212(1), 250(1) (current to 2026-10-19); CRA: Treaty based waivers involving Regulation 102 withholding (page details 2020-06-25); CRA: Determining your residency status (page details 2026-01-20)

rows.label: Property tax (municipal and school taxes) [provincial and municipal]
rows.value: Rates set locally on assessed value; no federal property tax (Underused Housing Tax nil from 2025). Paid by property owners. Constitution Act, 1867, s. 92; provincial municipal and education statutes

source.title: Constitution Act, 1867, s. 92 (Justice Laws Website)

rows.label: Property transfer tax (provincial land transfer taxes and fees) [provincial and municipal]
rows.value: Rates set by each province (e.g. Ontario, British Columbia, Quebec, Manitoba, Nova Scotia) and some cities; federal ban on non-Canadian buyers of homes. Paid by buyers of real property. Provincial land transfer statutes; Prohibition on the Purchase of Residential Property by Non-Canadians Act

rows.label: Income tax surcharge: federal surtax on income not earned in a province [national]
rows.value: 48% of basic federal tax on the share of income not earned in a province (instead of provincial tax); Ontario adds its own surtax and Health Premium (Ontario page). Paid by non-residents and others with income not earned in a province. Income Tax Act s. 120(1).
